spec.title: Error Rate

spec.title: Request Troughput
spec.description: Requests elaborated by the service over time

spec.title: P95 Latency
spec.description: 95th percentile of HTTP request latency over time for the selected service.

spec.description: Requests elaborated by the platform

spec.title: Global Request Rate
spec.description: Requests elaborated by the platform

spec.title: Heap Memory Usage

spec.description: V8 heap memory usage broken down by heap space.

spec.description: Resident memory used by the process.

spec.title: Memory Usage Over Time
spec.description: Memory usage over time.

spec.title: Event Loop Lag P99

spec.description: Number of active resources currently managed by the Node.js process.

spec.description: Number of active requests currently handled by the Node.js process.
